Anchorage, AK · Muldoon / East Anchorage

Tuesday Night Social Road Ride (Taco Tuesdays) is a road and gravel group ride in Anchorage, AK. It meets every Tuesday, 6:30 pm, through the summer, starting at Bartlett High School student parking lot. Pace: no-drop, two-abreast peloton.

About the Tuesday Night Social Road Ride (Taco Tuesdays) group ride

A no-drop Tuesday night road ride started to give Anchorage roadies something they can count on every week. Meets at the Bartlett High lot, rides the Glenn Highway path out toward Eagle River, and ends at tacos or pizza. Rain or shine. Road or gravel bikes recommended.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
